name: Feature Request
about: Suggest an idea or architectural improvement for RingCache
title: "[FEATURE] "
labels: ["enhancement"]
assignees: ''
---

## Problem Statement / Motivation
A clear and concise description of the problem or limitation this feature addresses. (e.g. *I am experiencing performance bottlenecks when...* or *The cache currently lacks support for...*)

## Proposed Solution
A clear and concise description of the feature or architectural change you want to propose. Explain how it integrates with the consistent hash ring, storage engine, or network layer.

## Alternatives Considered
A clear and concise description of any alternative solutions, designs, or workarounds you have considered and why they were rejected.

## Acceptance Criteria
Define testable criteria that must be satisfied for this feature to be considered complete:
- [ ] Functional requirement 1 (e.g., handles specific command or ring transition)
- [ ] Unit / integration tests covering the new behavior
- [ ] Concurrency and memory safety verified (ASan / TSan passing)
- [ ] Documentation and [docs/DESIGN_DECISIONS.md](../../docs/DESIGN_DECISIONS.md) updated if applicable

## Additional Context
Add any other context, benchmarks, API mockups, or architectural diagrams here.
